“international  voyage”,  and  the  substitution

“ “international voyage” means, a voyage between-

(a)
a port or place in Sri Lanka and a port or
place outside Sri Lanka; or

(b)
a port or place in a country to which the
Convention applies (other than Sri Lanka)
and a port or place in any other country or
territory which is outside Sri Lanka.”.
